connector.name: Virtual Filesystem
connector.registryDescription: PostgreSQL-backed virtual filesystem for agents: session isolation, shared stores, POSIX ops, RLS.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-virtual-fs. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lu-zhengda account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: VFS_ENABLE_RLS
env.description: Enable PostgreSQL Row Level Security for database-enforced session isolation
